questions.q: Doom blames which Fantastic Four leader for the scarring of his face?
questions.why: Doom blames Reed Richards for his disfigurement, fueling their rivalry.

questions.q: Doom renamed Latveria's capital Hassenstadt to what?
questions.why: He renamed the capital Doomstadt and Castle Sabbat became Castle Doom.

questions.q: Which actor played Doom in the 2005 film Fantastic Four?
questions.why: Julian McMahon played Doom in 2005 and 2007; Toby Kebbell in 2015.

questions.q: In which Fantastic Four issue did Doctor Doom first appear?
questions.why: He debuted in Fantastic Four #5, cover-dated July 1962.

questions.q: At which university did Victor von Doom meet the future Mister Fantastic?
questions.why: Doom earned a scholarship to Empire State University, where he met Reed.

questions.q: What was Victor attempting when his experiment exploded and scarred his face?
options: Open a portal to the Negative Zone
Rescue his mother's soul from Hell
questions.why: His machine to free his mother from Hell failed and the explosion scarred his face.

questions.q: Doom's witch mother was killed when he was a baby. What was her name?
questions.why: Cynthia Von Doom, a witch, was killed when Victor was a baby.

questions.q: Doom's origin was told in full in which 1964 issue?
questions.why: His full origin appeared two years after his debut, in FF Annual #2 (1964).

questions.q: In Secret Wars (2015), which patchwork world does Doom rule as a self-declared god?
questions.why: Doom and Doctor Strange build Battleworld from the broken multiverse; Doom rules it as a god.

questions.q: In which 2024 event does Doom take Doctor Strange's title of Sorcerer Supreme?
questions.why: Doom became Sorcerer Supreme after acquiring the title from Strange in Blood Hunt (2024).
